name: Beagle
intro: A beagle is a small, friendly dog. It has a great nose for smelling.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A beagle is a small hound dog.
It is about as tall as a grown-up's knee.
It has long, soft ears that hang down.
It has big brown or hazel eyes.
Its tail has a white tip.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Beagles first came from Great Britain.
Today many beagles live in homes as pets.
Beagles like to be with people and other dogs.
They need lots of playtime every day.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Beagles eat dog food.
Dog food has meat and vegetables in it.
A beagle's nose can sniff out food in bags.
Exercise helps beagles stay a healthy weight.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A mother beagle has about 6 puppies.
New beagle puppies are very tiny.
Some puppies are born black and white.
Their brown color comes in as they grow.
Beagles live about 12 to 15 years.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Snoopy from the cartoons is a beagle.
Beagles were first used to hunt rabbits.
Beagles work at airports to sniff bags.
A beagle makes a long howl called a bay.
Beagle fans call them merry dogs.

vocab.meaning: A dog that hunts by using its nose.
One kind of dog, like a beagle or a poodle.
A group of babies born at the same time.
A smell that an animal can follow.
